digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared none is neutral and contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance and prevents whole-container all-none classification
all_none is true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated none

Scope precedence is exact: own/cited/inherited dependency path yields paths; otherwise explicit parent none yields none; otherwise all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to none; otherwise result is unscoped
P9 passes leaves and containers with all live children declared and advises only live undeclared children as poisoners with path declaration or --none as remedies
Cheap resign preserves child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
